title: Ashley Madison: Sex, Lies & Scandal
overview: When a dating site for people seeking adulterous affairs is hacked, millions of users' intimate data is exposed, wrecking marriages and destroying lives.

title: Bad Vegan: Fame. Fraud. Fugitives.
overview: After marrying a mysterious man who claimed he could make her dog immortal, a celebrated vegan restaurateur finds her life veering off the rails.

title: Challenger: The Final Flight
overview: Engineers, officials and the crew members' families provide their perspective on the 1986 Space Shuttle Challenger disaster and its aftermath.

title: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
overview: Who really laced Tylenol with cyanide? This true-crime series examines alarming theories behind the unsolved killings — and tracks down a key suspect.

title: Dark Tourist
overview: The definition of "tourism" is redefined as New Zealand filmmaker David Farrier sets his sights on the world of dark tourism.  From nuclear tourism in Japan to Pablo Escobar-inspired tourism in Colombia to frontier tourism in Turkmenistan, David visits the world’s grisly and offbeat destinations, meeting travelers drawn to them, and the people telling these stories day after day.

title: Depp V Heard
overview: The story of the tumultuous defamation trial between superstar Johnny Depp and his former wife Amber Heard.

title: Dirty Money
overview: From crippling payday loans to cars that cheat emissions tests, this investigative series exposes brazen acts of corporate greed and corruption.

title: Drug Lords
overview: Witness the stories of history's most notorious kingpins, their terrifying enforcers, and the men and women who've sworn to bring them down.

title: Elize Matsunaga: Once Upon a Crime
overview: The crime shocked Brazil: Elize Matsunaga shot and dismembered her rich husband. Featuring her first interview, this docuseries dives deep into the case.

title: Empire Games
overview: This series explores the greatest empires in a way that has never been fully investigated. Each episode highlights and exposes the political intrigue, personal vendettas, family mayhem, acts of vengeance and the ever-evolving tension, turmoil and chaos that shaped these civilizations and led to their destruction from within.

title: Evil Genius
overview: This baffling true crime story starts with the grisly death of a pizza man who robs a bank with a bomb around his neck - and gets weirder from there.

title: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser
overview: Takes an inside look at the making of the hit reality TV competition, exploring the good, the bad, and the complicated. Featuring interviews with former contestants, trainers, producers, and health professionals, the documentary examines the show's approach to transformation, the support systems in place, and the unique challenges of filming reality television.

title: Hip Hop Evolution
overview: Hip-Hop today is a global culture that has changed music, dance, fashion, language —and even politics. But where did this worldwide cultural movement begin? We trace hip-hop back to its humble beginnings, when the kids of the Bronx crammed into house parties, rec rooms, and public parks to hear music like they’d never heard it before.

title: How to Change Your Mind
overview: Author Michael Pollan leads the way in this docuseries exploring the history and uses of psychedelics, including LSD, psilocybin, MDMA and mescaline.

title: Love Con Revenge
overview: Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.

title: Meltdown: Three Mile Island
overview: Insiders recount the events, controversies and lingering effects of the accident at the Three Mile Island nuclear power plant in Pennsylvania.

title: Monsters Inside: The 24 Faces of Billy Milligan
overview: In the late 1970s, an accused serial rapist claims multiple personalities control his behavior, setting off a legal odyssey that captivates America.

title: Murder Among the Mormons
overview: High-stakes exploits turn deadly — and shake a global church to its core — in this extraordinary true crime story.

title: My Encounter with Evil
overview: Real people who believe their lives were touched by demonic possession recount their experiences through reenactments and testimonies.

title: Raël: The Alien Prophet
overview: Featuring interviews with his followers, critics and Raël himself, this docuseries traces how a UFO-inspired religion spiraled into a controversial cult.

title: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model
overview: What started as a glamorous launchpad for aspiring models became a pop-culture juggernaut defined by explosive drama, public meltdowns, and controversies that still fuel viral moments today.

title: Roman Empire
overview: This stylish mix of documentary and historical epic chronicles the reign of Commodus, the emperor whose rule marked the beginning of Rome's fall.

title: Spy Ops
overview: Intelligence operatives from MI6 to the CIA share insider stories of spy craft, Cold War campaigns, and coups carried out by covert agents.

title: Surviving Death
overview: What happens after we die? This docuseries explores personal stories and research on near-death experiences, reincarnation and paranormal phenomena.

title: The Business of Drugs
overview: To detail how drugs push people into risky — even deadly — behaviors, a former CIA analyst investigates the economics of six illicit substances.

title: The Confession Tapes
overview: This true crime documentary series investigates cases where people convicted of murder claim their confessions were coerced, involuntary or false.

title: The Devil Next Door
overview: A Cleveland grandfather is brought to trial in Israel, accused of being the infamous Nazi death camp guard known as Ivan the Terrible.

title: The Family
overview: An enigmatic conservative Christian group known as the Family wields enormous influence in Washington, D.C., in pursuit of its global ambitions.

title: The Innocent Man
overview: In a story that gained national attention with John Grisham’s best-selling non-fiction book, The Innocent Man: Murder and Injustice in a Small Town, the six-part documentary series The Innocent Man focuses on two murders that shook the small town of Ada, Oklahoma, in the 1980s — and the controversial chain of events that followed.

title: The Kings of Tupelo: A Southern Crime Saga
overview: An Elvis impersonator's conspiracy theory sets off a feud that spirals into an attempted presidential assassination.

title: The Last Czars
overview: When social upheaval sweeps Russia in the early 20th century, Czar Nicholas II resists change, sparking a revolution and ending a dynasty.

title: The Lost Pirate Kingdom
overview: The real-life pirates of the Caribbean violently plunder the world's riches and form a surprisingly egalitarian republic in this documentary series.

title: The Mind, Explained
overview: Ever wonder what's happening inside your head? From dreaming to anxiety disorders, discover how your brain works with this illuminating series.

title: The Most Hated Man on the Internet
overview: Determined to remove her daughter's photos from a revenge porn website, a persistent mother launches an online crusade to shut down its cruel founder.

title: The Principles of Pleasure
overview: Sex, joy and modern science converge in this eye-opening series that celebrates the complex world of women's pleasure — and puts stubborn myths to rest.

title: Tiger King: The Doc Antle Story
overview: A lifelong showman, Bhagavan “Doc” Antle has built his various careers on theatrics, attracting a slew of admirers along the way. But beneath the eccentric, animal-loving facade lies a predator far more dangerous than his beloved big cats and a man shadier than any of his Tiger King counterparts.

title: Trump: An American Dream
overview: Friends, associates and critics reveal the truly American story of Donald Trump, the brash businessman who defied the odds to become U.S. president.

title: Unlocked: A Jail Experiment
overview: At an Arkansas detention facility, a sheriff implements a radical social experiment to grant men who are incarcerated more agency in this reality series.

title: Who Killed Malcolm X?
overview: Decades after the assassination of African American leader Malcolm X, an activist embarks on a complex mission seeking truth in the name of justice.

title: World's Most Wanted
overview: Heinous criminals have avoided capture despite massive rewards and global investigations. This docuseries profiles some of the world’s most wanted.

title: You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment
overview: Identical twins change their diets and lifestyles for eight weeks in a unique scientific experiment designed to explore how certain foods impact the body.

title: 900 Days Without Anabel
overview: Anabel Segura's abduction held Spain in suspense for 900 days. This docuseries explores the case through never-before-heard recordings of the kidnappers.

title: Angi: Fake Life, True Crime
overview: Sentenced for the murder and impersonation of her friend, this documentary sheds new light on Angi — and the death of her husband years before.

title: Bad Boy Billionaires: India
overview: This investigative docuseries explores the greed, fraud, and corruption that built up - and ultimately brought down - India's most infamous tycoons.

title: Can I Tell You a Secret?
overview: Three women's lives are changed forever when a prolific stalker infiltrates their social media accounts. And they're only a fraction of his many victims.

title: Club América vs. Club América
overview: This docuseries delves into the past, present and future of América, the most winning and controversial soccer club in Mexico, and its players' DNA.

title: Crime Stories: India Detectives
overview: With unprecedented access to the Bengaluru City Police, this gripping series follows major criminal investigations from the moment the crime is reported through to the capture of the suspects. From murder to kidnap to extortion, each film tracks a shocking and compelling case in the heart of India's Silicon Valley. Filmed with senior officers at home and at work, this is a unique window into the lives of Bengaluru's police officers as they attempt to detect the most complex and serious crimes in the city.

title: From Rock Star to Killer
overview: In 2003, rock singer Bertrand Cantat killed his partner, actress Marie Trintignant. This documentary revisits the case that divided a nation.

title: Garnachas: Glorious Street Food!
overview: A flavorful exploration of Mexico's street food scene, where the beloved garnacha takes center stage, sparks debates and unites fans with every bite.

title: Gunther's Millions
overview: A dog with a trust fund isn't the strangest part of this story. Gunther's eccentric handler also lived a luxe life — with a cult-like entourage.

title: Immigration Nation
overview: With unprecedented access to ICE operations and moving portraits of immigrants, this documentary series takes a deep look at US immigration.

title: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
overview: This jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.

title: MerPeople
overview: Welcome to the whimsical world of professional mermaiding, where people's passion for swimming in fins has exploded into a half-billion-dollar industry.

title: Mr. Good: Cop or Crook?
overview: In this riveting docuseries, when Norway's top cop is suspected of drug trafficking, investigators must ask: Is he a good officer or a major criminal?

title: Muscles & Mayhem: An Unauthorized Story of American Gladiators
overview: In the '90s, TV's stunt-filled "American Gladiators" thrilled fans. This docuseries explores the show's success — and how it almost ended before it began.

title: My Love: Six Stories of True Love
overview: Inspired by the acclaimed Korean documentary My Love, Don't Cross That River, the poignant series MY LOVE documents a year in the lives of six elderly couples from around the world. Globe-trotting through Brazil, India, Japan, Korea, the U.S., and Spain, the six-part docuseries gets to the heart of long-lasting love.

title: Norway: The Dark Horse
overview: After 26 years of tournament drought, Norway's 2026 World Cup hopes were next to nil. But what followed rekindled belief.

title: Paparazzi King
overview: Explore the life and career of paparazzi king Fabrizio Corona, reflecting Italy's recent history of scandals and social change.

title: Pepsi, Where's My Jet?
overview: When a 20-year-old attempts to win a fighter jet in a Pepsi sweepstakes, he sets the stage for a David versus Goliath court battle for the history books.

title: Start Up, Fall Down: From Billionaire to Convict
overview: One of Milan's most exclusive parties takes a dark turn when a woman reports sexual assault. This documentary chronicles the investigation that followed.

title: Take That
overview: The story of one of the greatest boy bands in UK history. For more than 30 years, they have brought us hit after hit, 12 of which became UK number ones.

title: The Andy Warhol Diaries
overview: After he's shot in 1968, Andy Warhol begins documenting his life and feelings. Those diaries, and this series, reveal the secrets behind his persona.

title: The Confession Killer
overview: Henry Lee Lucas rose to infamy when he confessed to hundreds of unsolved murders. This docuseries examines the truth -- and horrifying consequences.

title: The G Word with Adam Conover
overview: Love it or hate it, the government plays a huge role in our lives. Adam Conover explores its triumphs, failures and how we might be able to change it.

title: The Man with 1000 Kids
overview: A group of families learn the charismatic man they had trusted is sperm donor to hundreds — or perhaps thousands — of other children across the world.

title: The Many Deaths of Nora Dalmasso
overview: Who killed Nora Dalmasso? In this true-crime series, family and journalists share the untold story of her murder and the media storm that followed.

title: The Outreau Case: A French Nightmare
overview: A tragic affair of child abuse and judicial disaster, this docuseries revisits the Outreau case, one of the biggest scandals in French history.

title: The Pharmacist
overview: After his son's tragic death, a Louisiana pharmacist goes to extremes to expose the rampant corruption behind the opioid addiction crisis.

title: Bling Ring: Hollywood Heist
overview: As Nick and Rachel's crimes escalate to bigger and bigger stars, CCTV footage of the Hollywood Hills burglars begins to circulate the gossip blogs. Alexis and her family are on the brink of reality TV fame, but her drug issues spiral.

title: The Ripper
overview: For five years, from 1975 to 1980, the Yorkshire Ripper murders cast a dark shadow over the lives of women in the North of England. 13 women were dead and the police seemed incapable of catching the killer. No one felt safe – and every man was a suspect.

title: Vatican Girl: The Disappearance of Emanuela Orlandi
overview: Rome, 1983. After leaving a music lesson, 15-year-old Emanuela Orlandi vanishes — embroiling the Vatican in a decades-long mystery.

title: Vendetta: Truth, Lies and the Mafia
overview: Sicily boasts a bold "Anti-Mafia" coalition. But what happens when those trying to bring down organized crime are accused of being criminals themselves?

title: Working: What We Do All Day
overview: For some, it's a paycheck. For others, it's a calling. This docuseries explores the meaning of work for modern Americans in a time of rapid change.

title: American Manhunt: The Boston Marathon Bombing
overview: Archive footage, chilling reenactments and exclusive interviews shed new light on a tragedy — and two brothers — that suspended a city in terror.

title: American Murder: Gabby Petito
overview: What happened in the final days of Gabby Petito's life? In this gripping true-crime series, her loved ones reveal the untold story of her tragic murder.

title: American Murder: Laci Peterson
overview: Laci Peterson was eight months pregnant when she vanished, sparking a search that ended in tragedy. This docuseries delves into the 2002 murder case.

title: American Nightmare
overview: After a harrowing home invasion and kidnapping in 2015, a couple is accused of staging the ordeal when the woman reappears, haunting the couple with a new series of tortures.

title: Attack on London: Hunting the 7/7 Bombers
overview: Insider accounts and never-seen-before footage tell the story of the 7/7 bombings on London's transport network in 2005 — and its explosive aftermath.

title: Bad Influence: The Dark Side of Kidfluencing
overview: In this eye-opening documentary exposé, teens and parents reveal disturbing accounts of abuse and exploitation within the world of child influencers.

title: Bad Surgeon: Love Under the Knife
overview: Dr. Paolo Macchiarini is world famous for his revolutionary stem cell-infused windpipe transplants. There's just one problem: His patients keep dying.

title: Cocaine Air: Smugglers at 30,000 Ft.
overview: 2013: four Frenchmen are arrested in Punta Cana with 700 kg of cocaine — none fit the trafficker profile. This documentary asks: who was behind the bust?

title: Cold Case: Who Killed JonBenét Ramsey
overview: Police missteps and a media circus derailed the JonBenét Ramsey murder case. This definitive docuseries chronicles the decades-long quest for justice.

title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
overview: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

title: Crime Scene: The Vanishing at the Cecil Hotel
overview: The notorious Cecil Hotel grows in infamy when guest Elisa Lam vanishes. A dive into crime's darkest places.

title: Critical: Between Life and Death
overview: From critical emergencies to the operating room, this documentary series follows London's trauma centres as they treat the most severely injured.

title: Don't F**k with Cats: Hunting an Internet Killer
overview: A twisted criminal's gruesome videos drive a group of amateur online sleuths to launch a risky manhunt that pulls them into a dark underworld.

title: Dynasty: The Murdochs
overview: Offers an unprecedented look at one the world’s most powerful families at a crossroads, as its patriarch, Rupert Murdoch, makes one last play to ensure his legacy at all costs.

title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
overview: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

title: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
overview: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.

title: Harry & Meghan
overview: From their courtship to their exit from royal life, Harry and Meghan share their complex journey in their own words in this docuseries.

title: Katrina: Come Hell and High Water
overview: Twenty years after Hurricane Katrina, survivors reflect on the disastrous storm that forever changed their lives and the systemic inequities it exposed.

title: Killer Inside: The Mind of Aaron Hernandez
overview: Via interviews with friends, players and insiders, this docuseries examines how Aaron Hernandez went from an NFL star to a convicted killer.

title: Killer Sally
overview: Interviews with friends, family and Sally McNeil herself chart a bodybuilding couple’s rocky marriage — and its shocking end in a Valentine's Day murder.

title: Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street
overview: This docuseries follows the rise and fall of financier Bernie Madoff, who orchestrated one of the biggest Ponzi schemes in Wall Street history.

title: Mr. McMahon
overview: WWE experienced record-breaking highs and crushing lows under Vince McMahon's leadership. This docuseries delves into the mogul's controversial reign.

title: Murdaugh Murders: A Southern Scandal
overview: Shocking tragedies shatter a tight-knit South Carolina community and expose the horrifying secrets of its most powerful family.

title: November 13: Attack on Paris
overview: Survivors and first responders share personal stories of anguish, kindness and bravery that unfolded amid the Paris terror attacks of Nov. 13, 2015.

title: Sins of Our Mother
overview: When Lori Vallow's kids vanished, the search for them unearthed a trail of suspicious deaths, a new husband who shared her doomsday views — and murder.

title: The Christine Jessop Story
overview: On Oct. 3, 1984, Christine Jessop went missing in Queensville, Ont. Three months later her body was found, and it would be another 35 years until the mystery was finally solved. Over three, hour-long episodes, for the first time ever, Christine’s family speaks shares their story including a desperate search for answers, a falsely accused suspect, corrupt policing, revolutionary forensics, and a family forced to go through the unthinkable.

title: The Disappearance of Madeleine McCann
overview: The documentary takes a detailed look at the disappearance of 3-year-old Madeleine McCann, who vanished while on holiday with her family.

title: The Keepers
overview: This docuseries examines the decades-old murder of Sister Catherine Cesnik and its suspected link to a priest accused of abuse.

title: An American Murder Mystery: The Staircase
overview: Novelist Michael Peterson and his wife Kathleen are the toast of Durham, North Carolina. But that all changes on December 9, 2001, when Kathleen is found dead in her home at the bottom of a staircase. Michael claims it was a tragic, accidental fall. But was she murdered? In this three-part series, we investigate the shocking details of the case through the people closest to it. We'll also reveal a 16-year-old secret and examine one of the most dramatic trials in recent history.

title: The TikTok Killer
overview: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

title: The Trials of Gabriel Fernandez
overview: A boy’s brutal murder and the public trials of his guardians and social workers prompt questions about the system’s protection of vulnerable children.
